english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something continuing or happening throughout a period.
This is the all-purpose choice for an action continuing steadily over a period of time.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something continuing with no stated end.
Use this when the emphasis is on something remaining continuously true, such as staying popular throughout a period.
Use this when the state or action has continued throughout the period up to now or another reference point.
Use this when an action or state continues throughout a period or along a course, emphasizing its ongoing duration.
Use 一直 for an unbroken state or action continuing from a starting point, rather than a recurring habit.
Use this for something continuing for a period without interruption.

examples.traditional: 由朝早開始，我一直等緊你。
